author: Joshua Fluke
description:
A recruiter says they could have ended a job interview because the candidate’s first question was: “What’s the pay range?”

Apparently asking what a job actually pays before spending hours interviewing is a red flag now.

In this video, we’re looking at recruiters, hiring managers, CEOs, and corporate LinkedIn posts getting increasingly weird about salary transparency, compensation, personal finances, work-life balance, and the idea that caring about your paycheck somehow means you don’t care enough about the company.

Because yes — the money matters.

A company can have an amazing mission, incredible values, unlimited snacks, a ping-pong table and the most inspirational LinkedIn posts imaginable, but none of that pays your mortgage.

Then somehow it gets even stranger.

title: RECRUITERS ARE MAD YOU ASK WHAT THE JOB PAYS
